title: Saving a Part Library entry deleted in another tab is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a Part Library entry with no part behind it for this test, entry A: create a part at the test location, then delete it, so the entry stays with "Total parts" 0.
  • Use a new description for entry A, description 1.
  • Use a desktop browser that can open a second tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
  • Start in browser tab 1 on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. In tab 1, type entry A's part number in the Search box.
  2. In tab 1, click the entry A row.
  3. In tab 1, click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  4. In tab 1, replace the Description with description 1.
  5. Open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address.
  6. In tab 2, click Parts in the top bar.
  7. In tab 2, click Part Library in the left menu.
  8. In tab 2, type entry A's part number in the Search box.
  9. In tab 2, click the entry A row.
  10. In tab 2, click the pencil icon beside the entry's name.
  11. In tab 2, click Delete.
  12. In tab 2, confirm the deletion.
  13. Switch back to tab 1 without reloading it.
  14. In tab 1, click Save.
  15. In tab 1, click Parts in the top bar.
  16. In tab 1, click Part Library in the left menu.
  17. In tab 1, type entry A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Entry A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Its detail page opens.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens.

Step 4:

  • The Description field shows description 1.

Step 5:

  • A second tab opens.

Step 6:

  • Tab 2 shows the Parts left menu.

Step 7:

  • Tab 2 shows the Part Library page.

Step 8:

  • Entry A is listed in tab 2.

Step 9:

  • Its detail page opens in tab 2.

Step 10:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens in tab 2.

Step 11:

  • The confirmation asks "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?"

Step 12:

  • Tab 2 shows "Library part deleted successfully."

Step 13:

  • Tab 1 still shows the Edit Library Part window with description 1 typed.

Step 14:

  • The save is refused with a red message that reads only "Part Library entry not found.", with the smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."
  • "Failed to save library part." does not appear beside it, and no message uses the word "catalog" or "catalogue".

Step 15:

  • Tab 1 shows the Parts left menu.

Step 16:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 17:

  • No entry is listed for entry A's number: the refused save did not make it again.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S11-E4: “If a Part Library entry is deleted while its detail page is open elsewhere, for example in another browser tab, saving that page is refused with "Part Library entry not found."”
  • S12-R4: “The failure message when saving a Part Library entry reads "Failed to save library part." It shows only when the save fails for a reason this page does not name. A save refused for a named reason, such as S11-E4, shows that reason alone.”
  • S12-R5: “The success message when deleting a Part Library entry reads "Library part deleted successfully."”
  • S12-R11: “Refusals that name the shared list read: "This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted.", "Part Library entry not found.", "Part Library entry not found", "Part Library entry not found for ID: {id}.", "Part Library entry not found for part number: {part number}.", "Part Library entry missing category." and "A part from the Part Library must have Vendor as its source."”
  • Story 13, context note: “Context note: every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this." Messages the screen builds itself carry their own second line, as listed, or none.”

From: Product's answers (Chris Ward, 9 Oct and 14 Oct 2026, saved in po-answers-2026-10-09/ and po-answers-2026-10-14/), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 9 Oct 2026, answer 8: “B) "Part Library entry not found." New S11-E4.”
  • Chris Ward, 14 Oct 2026, answer 1: “Only "Part Library entry not found." (S11-E4). "Failed to save library part." shows only when a save fails for a reason the page doesn't name (S12-R4).”
